div.p: What is this screen? A quick way to send a customer request to Support or Sales without losing its context.

ul.li: Create a support ticket for a service problem or assistance request.
Create a CRM opportunity only for a real commercial request.
Pass the subject, details, responsible team, value, and expected date.

div.p: Start here: Choose the correct request type, write what the customer asked for in clear words, and select the team that must act. Add enough detail so the customer does not need to repeat the request.

button.name: action_submit
button.help: Create the selected record from the customer request: a Helpdesk ticket for support, or a CRM opportunity for a qualified commercial request. Review the subject, details, routing team, and expected value first.
Close this window without creating a ticket or opportunity. Information entered here will not be saved.
